Glimpses of College Events
  FROM THE PRINCIPAL'S DESK

     Welcome to Damdama College, Kamrup. I wish to
express my gratefulness to all the members of the college
community for giving me the opportunity to serve the
college. The college was established by the local
community on 9th of August,1978 with an aim to provide
higher education to the upcoming generations and to make
them self-reliant as well as competent citizens of the
nation.
     The college intends to translate these in to reality
through teaching, learning, evaluation, innovation,
research and extension. The college pledges to enlighten
rural poor by making them aware of the global changes
through education and co-curricular activities.
     Public Funded institutions like our college will
obviously face some challenges in maintaining the quality
and standard of higher education under the recent wave
of changes in economic as well as educational policies of
a global world. Therefore, it is the right time for all of us
to come forward and work together to face these
challenges. I hope our sincere efforts will make this college
a Centre of Excellence of higher education in the near
future.

                                    Sincerely Yours
                                  Dr. Suranjan Sarma
                                        Principal
                                   Damdama College

  A BRIEF HISTORY OF THE COLLEGE

      Damdama College was established on the 9th August, 1978 in
the temple town of Assam- Hajo. Set in the bustling locality of Kulhati,
the colleges have evolved as an institution of repute. The college has
six full-fledged departments and enrolls not less than fifteen hundred
students. The college sits on a campus of 44 bighas of land and is
easily accessible road. The nearest railway station is Kamakhya railway
junction at a distance of about 31 kms. The nearest airport is Lokapriya
Gopinath Bordoloi Inter-National Airport at Borjhar which is about 38km
from the college.
      In its initial years, the College attracted a very good pool of
teachers and scholars. Professor Dr. Gobinda Ch. Deka, an eminent
scientist along with late Prof. Tarinikanta Bhattacharya who retired as
Principal of Cotton College, who inaugurated the classes. Other
renowned scholars of the area like Mr. Bonkim Sharma retired Principal
Damdama H.S school and Mr. Pramod Ch. Deva Sharma Shashtri
contributed to the growth of this institution as a Centre promoting a
culture of democratic and liberal humanism.
      A brief history of this college must also include contributions of
the Damdama H.S. School this very famous school allowed its
classrooms to be used by the students of the college. Classes are
held from 7a.m to 11 am. Only on the 2nd January, 1982 classes
began within the college itself students and faculties collected bamboo
and other essentials to create makeshift rooms. Subsequently, degree
classes under the Gauhati University started in 1984. The government
declared the college grants in Aid institution in1989. It was
provincialized in 2005. The National Assessment and Accreditation
Council in the second cycle inspected the college on 2nd -3rd March
of 2023 and placed it in the B grade.
      The strength of this institution lies in academic achievement and
its healthy environment. A rural college catering to the academic needs
of local youths coming from agro-based working class family requires
a very soft careful managerial acumen in its build-up process. A
dedicated and learned faculty as well as the non-teaching personal
ensures that students develop their latent potential in a homely yet
intellectually stimulating environment it is our humble effort to provide
holistic education for the empowerment of the students as citizens of
the global world.

of the college. The Department was established in the year of

MISSION AND VISION OF THE COLLEGE:
      The motto of our college is "Gyaan Jyoti Diptam" or
"knowledge is power". The college aims at inculcating knowledge
and their latent potentials.
      Our vision is to plan for developing the college as an
institution of excellence that would provide our students with the
best of higher education and to make all possible efforts for
upgrading of the college to the status of a full-fledged multi-stream
institution.
GOALS AND OBJECTIVES:
      The college aspires to exude a harmonious blend of
traditional forms of teaching and Smart Class teaching facilities.
The college initiates various students' centric teaching-learning
methods, to provide ample opportunities to the students in various
fields through curricular and co-curricular activities.
LOCATION:
     Damdama College is 18 kms away from Jalukbari and
situated at the edge of Hajo-Nalbari road. Buses and other mini
vehicles are available from city centers like Jalukabri, Aminagaon
check-post and Adabari bus stand. The nearest railway junction
is Kamakya station and nearest airport is Lokapriya Gopinath
Bordoloi Interational Airport.

 Cells and Committees:
Internal Quality Assurance Cell:
     Under the UGC guideline, the college has an Internal Quality
Assurance Cell which monitors and works for the academic
progression as well as for the improvement of teaching- learning
process of the college through various quality initiatives. Also,
the cell provides suggestions to college administration for proper
function of the college.

Academic Committee:
     The college has an academic committee to ensure the
smooth functioning and monitoring of the academic activities of
the college. The academic committee constitute of academic in-
charge of the college and the H.o.Ds of the departments.

Anti-Ragging Cell:
     The College has an anti-ragging cell to look in to the ragging
related activities. The committee exercise the power conferred
by clause (g) of sub section 1 of section 26, of UGC act 1956
(UGC regulation on curbing the menace of ragging in higher
educational institutions 2009).

Grievance Redressal Cell & Internal Complaints Committee
     Damdama College has a grievance Redressal cell& Internal
Complaints Committee to look in to the problems of teachers, the
office staff and students.

Cell against Sexual Harassment:
     The college has a cell against Sexual Harassment which
looks into the issues of sexual harassment and protection of
students and employees.

                                  25
 Admission Cell:
     The college has an admission cell who works regarding
admission and other matters related to admission. The cell
constitutes of one Nodal officer, one co-ordinator and two
members.

Examination Cell:
     The college has an Examination Cell for looking after the
examinations of the college. The cell constitutes of the principal
of the college, academic in-Charge of the college, two teachers
as assistant in-charge and all the non-teaching Staff.

Career Counselling Committee:
     The college has a career counselling committee to provide
career guidance and mentoring to the students. The committee
invites renowned personalities for career guiding and organises
various career guidance seminars and workshops for the benefits
of the students. The Committee constitute of one teacher as co-
ordinator and two teachers of the college as the members of the
committee.

Entrepreneurship Development Cell:
     The college has an Entrepreneurship Development Cell to
promote entrepreneurship among students. The cell constitutes
of two convenor and Principal of the college and H.O.D of each
department of the college as members of the cell.

Institutional Innovation Cell:
     The college has an Institutional Innovation Cell for the
progressive and innovative planning of the college.

Research Cell:
     The college has a Research Cell to promote research works
among the teachers and the students of The College.
                                 26
 OBC Cell:
     The college has an OBC cell for the upliftment of OBC
students of the college. The cell provides counselling and
guidance to the O.B.C. students.

SC/ST Cell & Minority Cell:
     The college has SC/ST & minority cell for the upliftment of
the SC and ST community students and minority students of the
college to bring awareness for the SC and ST community &
minority students about their rights and benefits.

Women Cell:
     The college has a women cell for the empowerment of
women employees, female students and the local women.

Digital Cell:
     The college has a digital cell to look into the matters relating
to the ICT tools anything related to digital activities.

Students’ Union Body:
     For every academic session, the college organizes a student
union election, under the directive and principle of the Indian
Constitution. The aim is to make the student aw2are of their rights
and political responsibilities and also make them work out feasible
solutions to their issues. The elected body is known as Damdama
College Students' Union Body. Its membership is compulsory for
every student admitted in the college.

Alumni Association:
     The passed students of Damdama College have come
together to form the Damdama College Alumni Association. The
association holds regular discussions with authorities of the
college and help the institution develop further by contributing
money, books, books-shelves.
                                  27
 Festivals:
     Keeping in view the various religion-cultural background of
the students the college has made continuous effort to take care
of the different festivals such as celebration of Holi, Saraswasti
Puja, Fateha-E-Doyaz Doham.

Common Room:
     There are separate common rooms for boys and girls. Indoor
games facilities and medical facilities are available in the common
rooms.

Extension Activities of the college:
     The college under different cells and committees carries out
various extension activities in every academic session. The NSS
unit of the college has organise various activities and awareness
programmes in the campus and in the localities such as health
camps, flood relief, distribution of free books and stationery,
campus cleaning and plantation drive. The college has adopted
Hadala Village under the social outreach programme. The college
provides economic assistance to the women weavers of the village
and the IQAC of the college has taken the initiatives to open up a
selling centre named "Ikigai" for the selling of their products. The
teachers of the college visit and teach the children of the Hadala
L.P School periodically.
